QuestInfo.name: Dollhouse
QuestInfo.0: Visit Delv the Toy Soldier in Eos Tower.
QuestInfo.1: You met #bOlson the Toy Soldier#k who's standing guard with Delv on 100th Floor of Eos Tower. Olson told you that a monster that came through a Crack in Time ran off after stealing a pendulum from the Ludibrium Clocktower, and disguised itself as a Doll's House in this room. You must find a slightly different Doll's House among all the Houses inside.
QuestInfo.2: Inside the secret room of Eos Tower, I located the monster disguised as a dollhouse, destroyed it, recovered the pendulum, and gave it to Mark the Toy Soldier. This should get the Ludibrium Clocktower to start working again.

0.0: Hello, traveler. You have a face that tells me you'd kindly help without hesitation when a bystander asks for help. And I'm not just saying that. I mean it.
0.1: I'm such a good judge of character. Now, I want to help out #bOlson the Toy Soldier#k, since he always looks so serious. He needs to loosen up!
0.2: Please see what's bothering him and help him out. If he's happy, then I'm happy. Go on, ask #bOlson the Toy Soldier#k what he needs. I hope you can help him perk up!
